calculation_steps: Read prior exact matrices and factor L_N=s B_N(t), t=s².
Compute det and inverse of B_N(0)=M1; infer local invertibility for sufficiently small nonzero s.
Use C0=M1^-1, Cn=-C0 sum_{k=1}^n Bk C(n-k) to invert B as a rational formal series, and verify the product equals I through the available degree.
Multiply B7 B13^-1 and B13 B19^-1 to obtain first corrections at t4 and t6, respectively.
Audit supplied ledger, pinned UD local source and the actual tiny attachment bytes for a graphite packet preparation law.
